rubric.evidence: Every shipped WebIDL signature, mixin placement (Element, ShadowRoot, NonDocumentTypeChildNode -> Element/CharacterData, Document, TrustedTypePolicy), and Blink C++ guard verified directly against Chromium trunk (element.idl, shadow_root.idl, non_document_type_child_node.idl, document.idl, trusted_type_policy.idl/.cc, trusted_type_policy_options.idl, trusted_html_parser_options.idl, container_node.cc, node.cc, html_stream.cc), WHATWG HTML, WICG explainer, BCD, webstatus.dev html-streaming-setters, and ChromeStatus 5054329641893888 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5054329641893888 appears under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=157 with listing name 'Renewed HTML insertion&streaming methods'; slug renewed-html-insertion-streaming-methods matches lib/chromestatus.ts; H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus row present; links back to /v148/ and /v153/ trial history.

Implementation-sufficient reference covering all 22 new positional/streaming methods across Element/ShadowRoot/CharacterData, SetHTMLOptions/SetHTMLUnsafeOptions.runScripts, setHTMLUnsafe(), Document.parseHTMLUnsafe(), and TrustedTypePolicy.createParserOptions()/TrustedHTMLParserOptions across all nine required dimensions with zero outOfScope exclusions.

Clearly documents safe vs *Unsafe naming split, detached-node no-op vs HierarchyRequestError difference between positional and streaming sibling methods, <html> partial-insertion guard, <template>.content targeting, <script> NotSupportedError, TextDecoderStream requirement, and non-fungible TrustedHTMLParserOptions.

Provides doc-tested JS examples for positional methods across Element/ShadowRoot/CharacterData, WritableStream streaming with TextDecoderStream, SetHTMLUnsafeOptions.runScripts, and Trusted Types createParserOptions(), plus related links to the v152 CPS interactive demos.

Honest Limited availability Baseline banner (Chrome 157, Edge 157; Firefox positive; Safari no formal signal) backed by webstatus.dev html-streaming-setters and BCD across Element, ShadowRoot, CharacterData, TrustedTypePolicy, and TrustedHTMLParserOptions, plus link to GoogleChromeLabs/html-setters-polyfill.

Every visible source/citation label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; CPS demo and parent conformance route verified HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27 on the current Cloudflare Workers origin.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned compat table with <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap and <pre tabindex='0'> regions with :focus-visible outlines, and role='note' Baseline banner.
Verified with node scripts/conformance.mjs --responsive --page v157/renewed-html-insertion-streaming-methods (desktop:ok mobile:ok) with zero horizontal overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3.

No dedicated /v157/ CPS demo exists yet (HTTP 404); the sibling v152 CPS demos (streaming-html, positional-methods, feature index) are linked with data-demo-rel='related' so manifest demo stays honestly null.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation scrollable data table code blocks accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), use sequential headings, provide <caption> and <th scope> on data tables, and make scrollable code/table containers keyboard-focusable with clear :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, sequential h1/h2/h3, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned compat table with <th scope='col|row'>, tabindex='0' on .table-wrap and <pre> blocks with 3px :focus-visible outline.

guidanceConsulted.query: dark mode color-scheme semantic tokens typography legibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), avoid clipping overflow with overflow: hidden, and rely on shared design tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, horizontal scroll containers never clip content, and all styling uses /public/styles.css variables.

guidanceConsulted.query: dark mode color-scheme semantic tokens typography legibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic CSS custom properties so light and dark color schemes maintain WCAG AA contrast.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: zero hard-coded text/border colors; focus outline uses var(--accent-blue) and borders use var(--border-black) from /public/styles.css.
